verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West offers client-facing technology, including a trademark extranet, AI review tools and Fenwick Labs web services, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, giving no sign of any agent-facing interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
